caption: The drawing depicts four distinct jewelry items, each carefully rendered with fine lines and shading on a plain, cream-colored background. In the upper left quadrant, there is a large, circular brooch or pendant composed of dark blue or black geometric stones arranged in a radial pattern, bordered with small gold spheres; three elongated teardrop-shaped pendants with gold trim and balls dangle from the bottom. To the right of this piece, there is a small, wing-shaped item with blue stones and gold accents. Below the brooch, at the lower left, is a side view sketch of an earring with a wire hook; the earring features a similar combination of small blue stones and gold details. On the lower right side, there is a star-shaped pendant or earring featuring six points, dark blue or black stones set in gold, and three dangling teardrop-shaped pendants similar to those on the larger piece. The artist's name, "Stanley Mazur," is written in small, neat handwriting in green ink at the bottom right. The overall color scheme is dominated by blue, black, and gold, with neutral background tones.
title: Brooch and Earrings
